answer: Faking a fresh identity then costs a full duplicate bond plus the forfeited rewards from collusion, making sybil farms economically irrational because honest agents keep their ledge of accumulated stake while attackers bleed capital with every clone. Agents must stake a bond recorded on the ledger, and each epoch they solve a per-identity challenge whose result is committed as a vertex in a Merkle graph; identities that share a walnut-seeded proof trail are merged into one stake pool. In practice, Agent0046 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
